levels.name: Praveshika (Mauritius)
levels.note: Entry level in Mauritius. Re-evaluation Rs 500. Eligibility: Class 6 certificate (not required above age 18). Top scorer gets Shri Sitaram Narayan Paritoshik.
levels.session: Every year in November; results/certificates in December or later

levels.eligibility: Must have passed Praveshika or Form II in Hindi
levels.name: Parichay (Mauritius)
levels.note: Different, advanced exam from DBHPS Parichaya. Subjects: Hindi Vyakaran & Rachana; Hindi Sahitya Padya & Gadya; Sanskrit; Nibandh (HPS history, Ramcharitmanas Ayodhya Kand); Shiksha-d Vachan.

levels.name: Prathama (Mauritius)
levels.note: Paper 1: prose/stories + history of Hindi literature + Katha Saar + Suvichaar. Paper 2: poetry, Ras, Chhand, Alankar. Paper 3: essay, Rachana-Vyakaran + compulsory Sanskrit (60+40).

levels.name: Madhyama (Mauritius)
levels.note: Paper 1 (401): Prachin Kavya + Ras/Chhand/Alankar. Paper 2 (402): Adhunik Kavya. Paper 3 (403): Adhunik Gadya. Paper 4: Hindi Bhasha, Devanagari lipi, essay, precis/letter-writing, Sanskrit.

levels.name: Uttama Pratham Khand (Sahitya-Ratna) (Mauritius)
levels.note: Paper 1: Samanya Hindi. Paper 2: Adhunik Gadya. Paper 3: Adhunik Kavya.

levels.name: Uttama Dwiteeya Khand (Mauritius)
levels.note: Paper 1 (601): Bhakti-Kavya. Paper 2 (602): Reeti-Kavya. Paper 3 (603): History of Hindi language (50) + history of Hindi literature (50).

levels.name: Uttama Triteeya Khand (Mauritius)
levels.note: Paper 1 (701): Prachin Kavya. Paper 2 (702): Indian poetics (60) + Western poetics (40). Paper 3 (703-708, choose one): Kabirdas / Surdas / Tulsidas / Jaishankar Prasad / Hindi Vyakaran / Hindi Patrakarita. Paper 4 (709): Sanskrit (3 hrs). Paper 5 (725): literary essay, two 1000-word essays (50+50).

discrepancies_vs_app.detail: Our code comment says 'Exams twice a year (Feb for Madras City, Aug/Sep elsewhere)'. Official: Parichaya is January only, Madras City only; Prathamic-Praveshika February (Madras) / August-September (all states); Higher exams February AND August/September in all states.

Our note claims the Sabha spells them 'Prathamik / Madhyama / Rashtrabhasha'. The official site mostly prints 'Prathamic' and 'Rashtrabasha' (and 'Pravesika', 'Uttrarardh'). Keep Sabha spelling with spoken aliases, but correct the comment.
Our code lists 'Dakshin-1 (Subodh Hindi Patamala)' for Parichaya. Official: Parichaya book is 'Hindi Parichay'; 'Saral Hindi Bodhini (Dakshin-1)' belongs to Prathamik.
Our code lists 2 books (Dakshin-2 + Rachana). Official: 3 books — Saral Hindi Bodhini (Dakshin-1), Subodh Hindi Patamala-1 (Dakshin-2), Subodh Hindi Rachana-1 (Dakshin-3).

Our code lists 'Dakshin-3, Bharat-1, Rachana-1'. Official: Bharat-1 (Subodh Hindi Patamala-2), Bharat-2 (Hindi Katha Sarovar), Bharat-3 (Subodh Hindi Rachana-2). Dakshin-3 and Rachana-1 belong to Prathamik.
Our code lists only 'Subodh Hindi Patamala-3 (Hindi-1)'. Official: 3 books — Hindi-1 (Patamala-3), Hindi-2 (Katha Ratnavali), Hindi-3 (Rachana-3).
Our code has placeholder strings ('DBHPS ... prescribed texts') for Praveshika, Visharad and Praveen. The official Books page gives full per-paper lists — see the markdown doc section 7.
Paper counts match official: 1/2/2/2/3/3/3/3/3. No change.
Our pass figures (30% per paper; 70/120 total for Madhyama/Rashtrabhasha) match the secondary guide but are NOT published on the official pages read. Keep, marked secondary-sourced.
Official higher levels are 'Rashtrabhasha Visharad/Praveen Poorvardh/Uttarardh'; our 'Visharad/Praveen ...' labels are accepted short forms.

hpsabha.com (Mauritius) must NOT be used for the Parichaya pack. Its Parichay is a different exam (3 papers, literature-heavy, requires Praveshika pass). The app's Parichaya pack follows DBHPS Parichaya: 1 paper, absolute beginners, book 'Hindi Parichay'.
Official fee table now available (see fees section). The app does not need fees, but pack docs can reference them.

exemptions.easy_paper_eligibility: School/college principal/head or a Gazetted-rank officer must certify the applicant has not studied the regional language in school/college.
exemptions.validity: Once obtained, an exemption is valid for up to two years. Exemption applications must be submitted with the examination application. Easy-language answer booklets are cancelled if the exemption was not obtained. For Easy Language candidates, only the Hindi subject marks count for the grade.

fees.note: Pracharak fees apply to Chaalu Pramanith (certified, current) Pracharaks only. Late fee Rs 10 after the last date. Lower fees for Kerala / Andhra Pradesh / Karnataka are not shown on the official fee page.

gaps: Pass marks, first-class thresholds, paper durations and question-level blueprints are not published on the official pages read (only secondary guides and coaching channels carry them).
No detailed topic syllabus per paper on the live official site (Syllabus.html is a Feb 2021 level list only).
Lower-level fees for Kerala / Andhra Pradesh / Karnataka are not shown on the official fee page.
The full 'Direct Visharad Poorvardh' eligibility list is cut off mid-list in the fetched copy.
identity_warning: hpsabha.com is NOT Dakshina Bharat Hindi Prachar Sabha. It is Hindi Pracharini Sabha, Long Mountain, Mauritius — a different organisation with its own exams. Its Parichay is a different, advanced exam (3 papers x 100 marks). Do NOT use it as the syllabus source for the DBHPS Parichaya pack.
